name: War Falcon presence tooltip shows the per-falcon Wingman reduction instead of 0% (#6220)
contract: War Falcon presence 680278 has two APPLY_AREA_AURA_OWNER effects (dummy and 1 Focus per second) that reach the Ranger and one APPLY_AURA effect, a -2 flat modifier, that stays on the falcon. Its client tooltip ends with '$?s705098[ Reduces damage taken by ${$w3}%.][]'. The Ranger's application never carries effect 2, so SMSG_ASCENSION_AURA_AMOUNT sends 0 for it and the Ranger's buff reads 'Reduces damage taken by 0%' while Wingman 705098 is known. The reduction itself already works: ranger-wingman-war-falcons measures it. Wingman's own authored text uses the static '$680278s3%' for the same per-falcon value, so the presence tooltip is streamed through coa_client_spell_description with '$s3%' and its native description kept verbatim. The captured SMSG_PATCH_SPELL row must carry the corrected text and no longer contain the live effect 3 amount. Rendered client text is outside the harness.

steps.label: The existing description stream is captured
The War Falcon presence row is emitted
The tooltip states the static per-falcon reduction
The tooltip no longer reads the Ranger's empty effect 3 amount
The Focus line is unchanged
steps.text: You have a War Falcon active! Generating 1 Focus per second.

steps.label: The native description is kept
steps.text: Shows how many War Falcons you have active.
